senses.gloss:
r. 3rd cl. (पिपर्त्ति)
1 To protect, to nourish.
2 To fill.
5th cl. (पृणोति)
To satisfy, to please or content.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (परति पारयत्ति)
To fill, as the stomach or a vessel.
r. 6th cl. (but with वि and आङ् prefixed, and ङ aff.) व्यापृङ् (व्याप्रियते)
To be busy or active, to labor, to make exertions: see पॄ.

r. 3rd cl. (पिपर्त्ति) 9th cl. (पृणाति) 10th cl. (पारयति)
1 To nourish, to protect.
2 To fill.
